content.title: 'The Amazing Digital Circus' Finale Episode 'The Last Act' Coming to Theaters with Fathom | Animation Magazine
content.text: Indie animation studio Glitch Productions and specialty theatrical distributor Fathom Entertainment are bringing the worldwide premiere of the “last act” of the animated web series phenomenon The Amazing Digital Circus to U.S theaters nationwide (and other countries) from June 4-7. Created by Gooseworx, The Amazing Digital Circus has surpassed 1 billion online views following its 2023 debut and was one of the Top 5 most-viewed Netflix shows globally in first two weeks of October 2024, 12 months post initial release, per Netflix. The theatrical presentation, The Amazing Digital Circus: The Last Act, combines recently released episode eight with episode nine — an all-new, hour-long series finale. The Last Act features the voices of Lizzie Freeman (Pokémon Horizons) as Pomni, Alex Rochon (Poppy’s Playtime) as Caine, Michael Kovach (Murder Drones, Lackadaisy) as Jax, Amanda Hufford (Genshin Impact) as Ragatha, Marissa Lenti (Borderlands 3) as Gangle, Sean Chiplock (The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild) as Kinger, Ashley Nichols (Lackadaisy) as Zooble, and more. The finale also features music composed by series’ veteran Evan Alderete (Hazbin Hotel) and art direction from Gobo3D. “Glitch Productions is proving itself as the ultimate disruptor to the traditional animation industry with The Amazing Digital Circus,” said Kevin Lerdwichagul, the studio’s CEO and co-founder. “Offering an alternative online distribution model that bypasses corporate oversight, maintains creative freedom and uplifts passionate, thought-provoking and visually-striking projects, we are thrilled to partner with Fathom and bring The Amazing Digital Circus: The Last Act to fans the series finale on the big screen across the U.S. in theaters nationwide.” Ray Nutt, CEO of Fathom Entertainment, added, “The Amazing Digital Circus has had a remarkable and organic rise in popularity these past couple of years, with an unparalleled fanbase that is yearning for its dramatic conclusion of the hit animated web series. Fathom is thrilled to partner with Glitch and bring the long-awaited episode nine series finale to theaters. Fathom continues looking for the most compelling theatrical content — regardless of format — and is leading the industry in redefining consumer expectations for what is possible on the big screen.” Synopsis: With Caine gone and the circus dark, the cast are left with only the mistakes and traumas of their pasts to keep them company. As the prospect of eternity closes in around them, they discover the truth about the Digital Circus and its history. Will they come to terms with what they uncover, or will they make… the other choice? Also, presumably at some point someone says something funny, because this ending can’t be that depressing, can it? Tickets for The Amazing Digital Circus: The Last Act are available now online and at participating theater box offices (locations are subject to change).
